def factor_tail_stress_underwater_volume_robust_120(df):
    '''Tail-risk stress: volume-confirmed downside persistence while underwater, using a smoother 120-day volume baseline.'''
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    volume = df_copy['volume']
    daily_ret = close.pct_change()
    downside_move = (-daily_ret).clip(lower=0.0)
    rolling_high = close.rolling(63, min_periods=10).max()
    underwater = close < rolling_high
    volume_ratio = volume / volume.rolling(120, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    volume_ratio = volume_ratio.clip(upper=3.0)
    stress = downside_move * volume_ratio
    stress = stress.where(underwater, 0.0)
    factor = stress.rolling(21, min_periods=5).mean()
    return factor.rename('factor_tail_stress_underwater_volume_robust_120')
